transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal month-end capital distribution routine, I'm reviewing the subsidiary's proposed $6,000,000 upstream dividend to the parent. The subsidiary currently reports $8,000,000 in distributable retained earnings, so on the face of it the proposed payment appears supportable. Before I authorize the distribution, I need each of you to flag any constraints from your areas: capital risk, tax, and subsidiary controllership. Are there any regulatory, tax, or accounting issues that would restrict or prevent this $6 million dividend? Please go ahead.
